messages:
jamie_cs: Morning team — AcmeCorp weekly health pulse. Heads up: tokens WoW +12% (longform chat), QoQ +42%. Throughput nominal but p95 latency creeping up in eu-west. Sharing quick ask: can we validate token mix, cost impact, and any infra triggers? :eyes:

oliver_data: pulling metrics now. quick snapshot from telemetry:
```
date, tokens, req/s, p95_ms, error_rate
2026-02-28, 1,100,000, 46.8, 165, 0.10%
2026-03-14, 1,388,000, 55.9, 210, 0.22%
2026-03-21, 1,555,000, 62.5, 235, 0.35%
```

kevin_se: i see the p95 uptick — correlates with two big batches from their ingestion worker around 02:00 UTC. We pushed a batching tweak yesterday, might not have fully taken. I'll run a targeted staging test. :wrench:

lina_csm: noted on errors. Renewal risk flag: usage growth looks healthy but error jump + customer-reported latency could surface in renewal convo. I've booked an enablement sync with their infra & PM for Thu 10am PT. Can someone prep a 5-min perf brief? :calendar:

deploy-bot: [deploy] service/batcher v1.12.3 -> v1.12.4 succeeded (2085001250) :rocket:

jamie_cs: thanks. Action items: 1) kevin—verify patch lowers p95 by EOD, 2) oliver—cost delta & per-route breakdown, 3) lina—run enablement and capture ask list. Also note: token mix shifted to `longform_chat_v2` prompts; check if templates added tokens. :memo:

oliver_data: uploaded CSV to weekly reports: https://drive.redwood/reports/acme-mar21.csv — quick cost delta: +9% QoQ, est $1.2k/mo incremental. Token mix: 68% chat longform, 22% short answers, 10% embeddings/others.

kevin_se: quick staging run: disabling continuous-batch for route `/v1/chat/acme_long` drops p95 from 235 -> ~165 (staging). Will canary this afternoon (target 2% traffic) and measure. If stable, roll remainder tomorrow morning.

lina_csm: i'll include that in the enablement agenda. Also collecting any prompt engineering changes from the customer repo — they recently added a confirm-loop. Might explain extra tokens.

jamie_cs: perfect. i'll draft a one-pager for Thu and include the renewal posture (low risk if p95 <200 and errors <0.2%). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
